characters.THEO: stickman fisherman, round white head, dot eyes, short black beanie, bright yellow raincoat, red scarf, thin black limbs

beats.vo: There's a lighthouse on an island where no ship has ever crashed.
beats.visual: Lonely white-and-red lighthouse on a tiny rocky island at dusk, stormy teal sea, ships passing safely in the distance, cinematic wide shot

beats.vo: Not one, in two hundred years.
beats.visual: Same lighthouse through the seasons, waves crashing on rocks below while a ship sails by untouched

beats.vo: The strange part? Nobody lives there.
beats.visual: Close-up of the lighthouse door, faded paint, seagull on the railing, empty windows

beats.vo: No keeper. No power lines. No boat has docked there since 1987.
beats.visual: Rotting empty wooden dock on the island, broken rope, a rusty sign reading 1987

beats.vo: But every night at exactly 8:14, the light turns on.
beats.visual: Night. The lighthouse beam suddenly blazes on, cutting across the dark sea, townspeople on the mainland pointing

beats.vo: So a fisherman named Theo rows out to see who's doing it.
beats.visual: THEO rowing a small red wooden boat toward the glowing lighthouse, determined face, choppy waves

beats.vo: The door is unlocked. He climbs all 312 steps.
beats.visual: Looking up a dizzying spiral staircase inside the lighthouse, THEO tiny at the bottom holding a lantern

beats.vo: At the top, the lamp is already burning. Still warm.
beats.visual: Lamp room at the top: a huge glowing brass lamp and lens, warm golden light, THEO squinting with a hand up

beats.vo: And there's one wooden chair, facing the sea.
beats.visual: A single old wooden chair in the lamp room, facing the window and the dark ocean, eerie rim light

beats.vo: Next to it, the floor is covered in tiny scratches. Thousands of them.
beats.visual: Top-down close-up of wooden floorboards completely covered in carved tally marks, THEO's boots at the edge

beats.vo: Tally marks. One for every night.
beats.visual: Extreme close-up of tally marks in groups of five, a few freshly carved with pale wood showing

beats.vo: And the last one was carved today.
beats.visual: THEO kneeling, touching the newest pale tally mark, wide terrified eyes, sweat drop

beats.vo: Then Theo hears footsteps, coming up the stairs.
beats.visual: View from the top of the spiral staircase looking down into darkness, a long shadow climbing, THEO frozen in the foreground
